params.body:
## Why

Second half of the modal migration, stacked on "Stocklist modals: Bootstrap grid/forms to the ui vocabulary" (merge that first; this branch contains it). The RealGarant programme tables, the contract modals and the offer page headers still carried Bootstrap `table`, `row`/`col-*`, `input-group`, `custom-switch`, `btn`, `alert` and `badge` markup.

## What per view

- `offertes/_tabs_offerte/_real_garant/table.blade.php`, `tableRow.blade.php`: `ui-rows-table` with the km affix; the template row that `addRGRow()` clones stays a plain `<tr data-start="true">`, `data-type`, `program(this)`, `calculate(this)` and the `real_garant[...]` names are unchanged. One fix: the mileage input in `tableRow` had a Blade `@if ... disabled @endif` inside the `<x-ui.input>` tag, which the component compiler does not process, so the tag rendered as literal text; it is now a bound `:disabled` prop.
- `offertes/_tabs_bestelbon/_real_garant/table.blade.php`: the programme radios as `ui-rows-choice` labels; the assistance switch written out as a `ui-switch` (not the component) because `rbChange()` enables it later and the component's locked look would not follow.
- `offertes/_tabs_bestelbon/_real_garant/_modals/create_contract.blade.php`, `new_contract.blade.php`: `.modal` shell kept (fetched by `modal.get`), body as a Tailwind grid, `x-ui.badge`, `x-ui.switch` with the hidden `1` written by hand as before, `ui-button` in the footer; the `updateCreateButtonState` selector follows (`.btn-primary` to `.ui-button--primary`), the JS-built alerts become `ui-modal-note--danger/--success`.
- `offertes/_tabs_bestelbon/_real_garant/_modals/files.blade.php`: `ui-contract-files`, remove button as `ui-row-remove`.
- `offertes/header.blade.php`, `headerContracts.blade.php`: `ui-page-head` as on the relation and user screens.
- `resources/css/refresh.css`: `ui-rows-choice`, `ui-rows-assistance`, `ui-contract-heading`, `ui-contract-files`, `ui-modal-note--danger/--success`, `ui-button--sm`, the switch guard extended to `#create-contract-modal`.

## Unused views found

See the first PR (`stocklist/_tabs/extendedSearch`, `stocklist/_tabs/filter`, `stocklist/index`). `offertes/_tabs_offerte/_real_garant/table.blade.php` is only reachable through the controller fallback in `RealGarantController@show` (the offer modal's RealGarant block sits behind `@if(1 == 2)`), so it is migrated but effectively dormant.

## Screenshots

`tw-modals-{before,after}-{contract,newcontract,rg-offer}-{1280,390}.png` in the session scratchpad, plus the order modal with the RealGarant lines injected (`order-*`). Rendered through the test kernel with an in-memory order and relation and fake programme data; the RealGarant service itself is not called.

## Checked

Same set as the first PR: compiled views lint, `SmokeTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Offer|Order|Pricing` green, `npm run build`.
